''See also: [[Sacred Valley Timeline]]''

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|Sacred [[the Valley|Valley]] is a mountain-enclosed paradise that was long considered a civilized sanctuary, isolated from the violent and barbaric lands beyond by its difficult terrain and weather. It is characterized by four [[holy peaks]] that serve as homes to major schools, and it contains ancient structures such as the [[Ancestor's Tomb]]. The region is protected by a massive, sophisticated [[Script|script]] formation buried deep underground, which was often mistaken for a curse. Beneath the valley lies the central hub of a vast, world-spanning [[labyrinth]]. The population consists of various clans, such as the Wei, and is home to many [[sacred artists]]. Cultural traditions include biannual spiritual testing for children and a festival held every seven years. While the valley was once thought to be a secluded haven, it has faced catastrophic destruction from external forces, including the [[Dreadgods]] and the [[Wandering Titan]]. Following these assaults, the valley's landscape was shattered, but it eventually became a densely populated refuge where diverse architectural styles and people from across the world coexist amidst the ruins.}}

== Unsouled ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-01-unsouled|Nestled within a mountain range and surrounded by untamed land inhabited by barbarian nomads, the Sacred [[the Valley|Valley]] is a paradise that many believe contains all settlements. This region, home to nearly a million people and the site where [[orus fruit]] grows, serves as a residence for [[sacred artists]] and a place where clans conduct Spiritual Origin tests using a bowl of liquid [[madra]]. While the [[Wei clan]] carved out a section of their wilderness here, the valley is protected by terrain, weather, and significant individuals, though it was once destroyed by a monstrous creature that buried the mountains in earth. Within this society, children can recite the definition of [[sacred arts]] on command, and those below [[Gold]] rank are viewed as powerless. Despite its status as a destination for [[Judge Suriel|Suriel]]'s course, the valley faces threats from [[Li Markuth]]'s territorial ambitions and is ultimately seen as too soft by [[Yerin]], who possesses more power than any [[Jade]] residing there.}}

== Soulsmith ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-02-soulsmith|Considered civilized in comparison to the [[Desolate Wilds]], Sacred [[the Valley|Valley]] serves as the home of the [[Wei clan]] and the site where [[Lindon]] received his education. While medical care is available within the valley, life for an [[Unsouled]] is difficult, as those carrying fortunes often become targets for robbery. The location houses [[Elder Whisper's tower]] and provides a space where [[Jade]]-stage practitioners can utilize spirit sensing. Although [[Yerin]] was more capable than anyone else in the valley, the term [[Unsouled]] holds no meaning outside of its borders. Furthermore, the area utilizes shadesilk for trade with the outside world and contains a connection to the door.}}

== Blackflame ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-03-blackflame|Located to the west, the Sacred [[the Valley|Valley]] is a region of towns and cities inhabited by [[Soulsmiths]] and home to various [[Jades]]. While the land surrounding it is considered barbaric and untamed, the valley itself serves as a site of conflict between the Wei and [[Li]] clans and is connected to the history of the [[Arelius family]]. [[Yerin]] has deep personal ties to the area, having lost her master's voice there nearly a year prior and previously engaging in combat with one of her master's [[Remnants]]. Despite [[Eithan]]'s inability to save the valley, a creature is destined to attack the region, though [[Lindon]] and [[Yerin]] eventually departed from the area.}}

== Wintersteel ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-08-wintersteel|Sacred [[the Valley|Valley]] is a location defined by its adherence to ancient traditions and serves as the birthplace of both [[Lindon]] and the [[Bleeding Phoenix]]. Deep beneath its earth lies a massive [[Script|script]] formation that generates a [[suppression field]] to stifle [[madra]], and the valley also houses the [[Ancestor's Tomb|Ancestor’s Tomb]]. Within this region, time and a curse have destroyed the sacred instruments kept in the hall, while local people maintain a strict rule to strike any [[Jade]] dead who enters their [[labyrinth]]. Currently, the [[Fate|fate]] of the valley is being decided by the [[Monarchs]], especially as a [[Dreadgod]] intends to travel there once it awakens.}}

== Bloodline ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-09-bloodline|Sacred [[the Valley|Valley]] is a territory containing four schools, three clans, and the [[Li clan]], which [[Lindon]] studied as a child. The region is subject to a [[suppression field]] and curse that prevents inhabitants from advancing beyond [[Jade]], interferes with contracts, and weakens techniques. As a [[Dreadgod]] approaches, the area faces an axe-like force and the threat of the [[Wandering Titan]], leading to a massive evacuation where [[Lindon]] uses his fortress' cloud to assist fleeing citizens. Despite efforts to draw the [[Titan]] away, the entity wades into the valley and destroys it, leaving refugees to flee into the forest or be ushered into the [[Desolate Wilds|Wilds]]. Following the destruction, the area is eventually re-settled one building at a time.}}

== Reaper ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-10-reaper|Located near [[Mount Samara]], the Sacred [[the Valley|Valley]] is a region characterized by [[spirit-sense|spiritual sense]] suppression and a landscape littered with [[Remnants]] following a [[Dreadgod]]'s rampage. After its residents sought shelter in the town of [[Refuge]] and established camps in the [[Desolate Wilds]], the people were eventually loaded onto cloudships for evacuation. The valley is currently surrounded by four cults and has become a site of clashing powers as Overlords and [[Archlord|Archlords]] fight over the territory. While the placement of the [[Silent Core]] in its chamber is expected to change the location, emergency gatekeys are being used to cordon off the area. This dangerous place, which contains pieces of [[labyrinth|the labyrinth]] and features badges with the [[Forger symbol]], remains a site where one could die.}}

== Dreadgod ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-11-dreadgod|The center of the Sacred [[the Valley|Valley]] was once leveled by a rampaging [[Titan]], an entity that [[Mercy]] has previously fought within the region. Currently, [[Northstrider]]'s [[cloud fortress]] hangs suspended over the valley. While [[Lindon]] and [[Dross]] felt a great distance from the area, [[Lindon]] remains unable to create a [[portal]] to the Sacred [[the Valley|Valley]] from [[Serpent's Grave|Serpent’s Grave]]. Despite this distance, [[Yerin]] adheres to the specific manners associated with the location.}}

== Waybound ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|Located far above [[labyrinth|the labyrinth]] and below the sky, Sacred [[the Valley|Valley]] is a distant territory containing three remaining sacred peaks. This ancestral home of [[Lindon]]'s people is protected by a great [[Script|script]] and a barrier projected by the great [[labyrinth]], though it can also rise from the sea. During intense conflicts, the area was targeted by [[Monarch]] techniques and pincered by a star and a shining blood dragon, even witnessing the clash of the gray-white echoed [[Titan]]. While [[Lindon]] visited the location via [[labyrinth|the labyrinth]], [[Akura Charity]] remained outside as [[Archlord|Archlords]] flew around the valley. Following these events, the region has undergone a rebuilding effort and remains the subject of information requests regarding its [[Spiritual Origin test]].}}

== Notable quotes ==
* {{spoiler|book=cradle-01-unsouled|Only nomads,” he said dismissively. “Barbarians. They have tamed some sacred beasts, and they roam around in caravans avoiding the greatest dangers.<ref name="cradle-01-unsouled-c15" />}}
* {{spoiler|book=cradle-03-blackflame|If I waited to fight until I was ready,” Yerin said, “my bones would be rotting in Sacred Valley right now.<ref name="cradle-03-blackflame-c13" />}}
* {{spoiler|book=cradle-04-skysworn|“Sacred Valley,” Lindon said. “It’s far to the west, past the Desolate Wilds.”<ref name="cradle-04-skysworn-c13" />}}
* {{spoiler|book=cradle-08-wintersteel|The sacred instruments that had filled this hall had been destroyed by time and by this valley’s “curse.”<ref name="cradle-08-wintersteel-c1" />}}
* {{spoiler|book=cradle-09-bloodline|“I hear you’ve been having quite the adventures here in Sacred Valley.”<ref name="cradle-09-bloodline-c10" />}}
